dict.Proces-verbal de predare-primire a echip: Handover report for personal protective equipment
dict.Echipamentul individual de protecție dat: Personal protective equipment issued to an employee (hard hat, gloves, boots, vest, goggles…): a table with the items, size, quantity and how long they are used, plus the employee's obligations and the signatures
dict.Căștile, mănușile, bocancii și celelalte: Hard hats, gloves, boots and other protective equipment issued to each employee: from the date received and the duration in months you get the replacement date and the days left; what must be replaced now shows in red, what expires within 30 days in yellow, and on the right also the items not signed for in the record.
dict.De înlocuit în următoarele 30 de zile: To replace in the next 30 days
dict.Duratele le stabilește firma (de obicei: The durations are set by the company (usually in its internal rules); protective equipment is provided free of charge.
dict.Procesul-verbal pentru fiecare predare:: The handover report for each issue: Docs → From template → Handover report for personal protective equipment.
dict.Un rând pe fiecare bucată dată: angajatu: One row for each item issued: the employee, the equipment, the size, the date received and how many months it is used.
dict.[Aprobăm comanda de [suma] lei: da / nu]: [We approve the order of [amount] lei: yes / no] · [who checks the signatures] · questions: [name] · [phone]
dict.[câte] predări nesemnate în fișă, de la: [how many] handovers not signed on the record card, since [month]
dict.[echipamentul]: înlocuit mai des decât d: [equipment]: replaced more often than the period in the table
dict.Angajații noi primesc echipamentul înain: New employees get their equipment before their first working day
dict.Bucăți fără dată de primire: [câte]: Items without a date received: [how many]
dict.Cifrele vin din Sheets → Evidența echipa: The figures come from Sheets → Protective equipment register (the Status column and the boxes on the right).
dict.Comandăm acum bucățile de înlocuit, cu m: We order the items to replace now, with the sizes from the register: [supplier], [amount] lei
dict.Evidența ținută la zi: Sheets → Evidența: The register kept up to date: Sheets → Protective equipment register
dict.Fiecare predare semnată în aceeași zi: D: Every handover signed on the same day: Docs → Handover report for personal protective equipment
dict.Nesemnate în fișă: [câte]: Not signed on the record card: [how many]
dict.Pentru administrator, o dată pe trimestr: For the manager, once a quarter: how many items of protective equipment are in use, what needs replacing now and within 30 days, what was not signed on the record card, by type of equipment, in a table and a chart, then what we buy and how much it costs.
dict.Schimbă cifrele din grafic cu bucățile d: Replace the figures in the chart with the items from the table above (double-click the chart).
dict.Spune dacă durata de folosire din eviden: Say whether the period of use in the register should be shortened for some workplaces (the health and safety officer decides).
